liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Visions of Johanna** (6 reviews, 1 other source): First time played since 4/22/86; Reviewer counts it among all-time favorite versions, linking its return to Greek Theater 86 [2][6][7][8][11][13][17]
- **I Just Wanna Make Love to You** (4 other sources): Notes mark it as first played since October 8, 1984; First time played since 10/8/84 [1][2][3][4]
- **Broken Arrow** (1 review): Reviewer counts it among all-time favorite versions [6]
- **Black-Throated Wind** (1 other source): Weir played acoustic guitar on this song [3]
- **Foolish Heart** (1 review): Described as a solid version [17]
- **Samba in the Rain** (1 review): Garcia is weaker here, never fully mastering the song [9]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Weir mixes up Truckin' and Busted lyrics, singing about being trusted down on Bourbon Street [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **tunin' & teasin'**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [18]
- **tunin' & teasin'**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [18]
- **I Just Wanna Make Love to You**: back after 778 archived shows (3788 days); rare: 4 archived performances [18]
- **Visions of Johanna**: back after 171 archived shows (781 days); rare: 10 archived performances [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1995-02-21.145492.akg460b.lerond.t-flac1648** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 150 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1995-02-21.140348.aud.miller.sirmick.flac1648**: audience recording; 17 songs; 147 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1995-02-21.sbd.miller.114144.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 143 min; rated 3.44/5 by 16 [3]
- **gd1995-02-21.sbd.serafin.walkerb.1524.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 139 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [4]. Said about its sound: A percussion-like sound, possibly a digital blemish, is audible in places but not in quiet passages [4]
- **gd95-02-21.dsbd.stephens.8840.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 17 songs; 142 min; rated 3.58/5 by 59 [5]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is crisp, with some persistent crackling; Persistent crackling overpowers this song; A series of large cracks and pops comes at the end [16][17]

## Around the show

- Attendee says first-set energy beat any show he had seen in years [8]
- Salt Lake City proved a big surprise, lifting the mood of band and fans [9]
- Garcia let Vince take some leads in Salt Lake City [10]
- Playing in Brigham's city; reviewer praises Weir's boldness in choosing the song [15]
- Considered one of the stronger 1995 shows, with a standout first set of Broken Arrow, Black-Throated Wind, So Many Roads [6]
- Judged the best of the Visions revivals; early show shows Garcia's wear and tear [7]
- Much more energetic than the previous two nights at the Delta [9]
- Better than the other, subpar Salt Lake shows [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1995-02-21.145492.akg460b.lerond.t-flac1648**: taped by Jean Lerond; transferred by Jean Lerond; source: AKGC60B+CK8x shotgun in OTS, ~34’ to St.L of C (inline w/hanging PA; aimed at the PA) > Panasonic SV-255 (Paul Tumolo’s rig) Analog or Digi out, possibly via… [1]. Also: Recording made with AKG 460B microphones, credited to lerond [1]
- **gd1995-02-21.140348.aud.miller.sirmick.flac1648**: transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source: unknown aud > dat (48k); Transfer: dat > Sony R500 > Tascam DA-3000 > wav 16/48; Lineage: wav > iZotope RX6 Advanced > Adobe Audition… [2]. Also: Audience recording matrixed with soundboard source 114144 from Charlie Miller, to cover right-channel dropouts in Truckin' [2]
- **gd1995-02-21.sbd.miller.114144.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat (44.1k) [3]. Also: Described as the only purely digital source in circulation [3]
- **gd1995-02-21.sbd.serafin.walkerb.1524.shnf**: transferred by Jay Serafin; source: SBD>D>CD-R>EAC>SHN [4]. Also: Processing (editing, noise reduction, EQ) done digitally at Serafin Station Studio B [4]
- **gd95-02-21.dsbd.stephens.8840.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD > 1C > DAT [5]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Robbi Cohn: [1995-02-20 Delta Center, Salt Lake City, UT, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1995-02-20-delta-center-salt-lake-city-ut-usa/) [19]
- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 2/21/95 Delta Center, Salt Lake …](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26759944603/) [20]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26759944603/) [21]
